touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Tetney qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST PETER AND ST PAUL and Cross in St Peter and St Paul's churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Tetney: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Tetney offers CHURCH OF ST PETER AND ST PAUL, Cross in St Peter and St Paul's churchyard, CHURCHYARD CROSS AT CHURCH OF ST PETER AND ST PAUL within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
